idea: Lily runs away at bath time and daddy chases her
title: Bath Time Escape
description: Every night. Same chase. She always wins.

scenes.image_prompt: Long cozy hallway at home in the evening. The little girl, wrapped in a pink hooded bath towel like a superhero cape, runs toward the camera laughing with her arms out. Behind her the dad chases her holding a yellow rubber duck, playful determined face. Dynamic wide shot.
scenes.action: The little girl runs toward the camera giggling, her towel cape flapping; the dad runs after her waving the rubber duck.

scenes.image_prompt: Living room in the evening. The dad slips on a toy car and slides across the wooden floor on his back, arms flailing, rubber duck flying in the air. In the background the little girl hides behind a curtain with only her tiny feet and pink towel showing. Wide shot.
scenes.action: The dad slips on a toy car and slides across the floor with arms flailing; behind the curtain the little girl's feet wiggle as she giggles.

scenes.image_prompt: Bright bathroom full of bubbles. The little girl sits happily in a bubble bath wearing a big bubble beard, and the dad kneels beside the tub also wearing a bubble beard, both laughing. Warm cozy close-up.
scenes.action: The little girl splashes the water and blows bubbles at the dad; the dad laughs and pats his own bubble beard.
